# ui::PickSaveFileOptions

Header: `winui/ui/Pickers.hpp`.

What [pick_save_file()](namespace-ui.md#pick_save_file) is asked for. Every field is optional.

Example: 
```cpp
auto path = ui::pick_save_file(window, {.file_types     = {{.name = "Text", .extensions = {".txt"}}},
                                        .suggested_name = "Notes"});
```

| Field | Type | Default | |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `title` | `std::string` |  | The dialog caption; empty keeps the default. |
| `commit_button_text` | `std::string` |  | The Save button's label; empty keeps "Save". |
| `file_types` | `std::vector<FileType>` |  | Named types for the type box. They win over `extensions`; "All Files" when both are empty. |
| `extensions` | `std::vector<std::string>` |  | Plain extensions (".txt"), one type-box entry each, plus one for all of them. Used when `file_types` is empty. |
| `initial_file_type` | `std::optional<std::size_t>` |  | Which type-box entry starts selected, zero-based. Unset (the default) selects the first named type, or with `extensions` the entry for all of them. |
| `default_extension` | `std::string` |  | Appended when the user types a name without one (".txt"); empty: the selected type's first. |
| `suggested_name` | `std::string` |  | The name the dialog opens with. |
| `start_location` | `PickerLocation` | `PickerLocation::Unspecified` | The known folder to open in when `folder` is empty. |
| `folder` | `std::filesystem::path` |  | The folder to open in, if it exists; absolute. Wins over `start_location`. |
| `remember_last` | `bool` | `true` | True: `folder` (or `start_location`) opens the first time, and after that the dialog reopens wherever the user last picked from. False: it opens every time. |
| `overwrite_prompt` | `bool` | `true` | Ask before replacing an existing file. |
